channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Tell-tale Rumblings of Yearner-core
item.description: In this edition of the Highsnobiety Shopper newsletter, we looked at the many examples of purposefully distressed clothes on runways, and what they mean.

item.title: With Everyone Else Doing Vans, Vans Is Now Doing... Camo Boots?!
item.description: From time-tested skate shoe to trail-ready hiking boot, the OAMC x Vans Half Cab is one of the most original new takes on a silhouette we’ve seen for a minute.

item.title: The Best Basketball Shoes of the 2025-26 Season
item.description: We take a look at the best basketball shoes of the 2025-2026 season, featuring signature models and in-line styles from adidas, Nike, Converse, and more.

item.title: I Don’t Know About These Fancy Bathhouses, Man
item.description: For those falling under the spell of the latest wellness craze, we regret to inform you that you’re missing out on the real thing.

item.title: Jonathan Anderson Just Brought Dior to UNIQLO
item.description: At Dior, Jonathan Anderson proposes a preppy uniform full of twists. For JW Anderson x UNIQLO SS26, he proposes a similarly waspy but more approachable look.

item.title: At a Rare Art Show, the Elusive Martin Margiela Gets a Little Less Anonymous
item.description: Famously taciturn fashion designer turned artist Martin Margiela has quietly announced a new art show. And he's provided some commentary on what to expect!

item.title: New Balance's Army-Coded Shredder Shoe Is Surprisingly Gorgeous
item.description: New Balance's Numeric 770 skate shoe is a war-ready thrasher that is ready to battle it out at any skate park, in this beautiful green colorway.

item.title: This Brand Is Dressing Gen Z Like '90s Ravers
item.description: BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS Spring/Summer 2026 collection gets to the heart of a truly mad time: the Madchester of the 1980s.

item.title: New Balance's Saucy Dad Shoe Is Best Served With Pasta
item.description: New Balance's zesty marinara-coated 740 dad shoe is so much more than just saucy. It's dripping.

item.title: Vans' Stunning Slip-On Boat Shoe Skates On Water
item.description: Vans' beautiful boat shoe is so normal in its simplicity, it might be the strangest thing Vans has ever done.
